svg.title: Ocr Trilogy
svg.desc: OCR trilogy: one Tesseract OCR engine shipped three ways. 2020: FastAPI on Heroku. 2021: Flask-RESTX image on Docker Hub. 2022: Flask web UI with Heroku and Azure continuous deployment. A scan beam sweeps a tilted page of pixelated words, boxes each word, and the recognised text types out beside it.
svg.text: Flask web UI · Heroku + Azure CD
